content: {"like":["The acting and singing were actually pretty good which was a nice surprise.","I enjoyed Anna Kendrick's voice quite a bit.","The children were good, and I think Red was channeling the Broadway cast soundtrack and Jack had a touch of something in there with his accent.","Both kids showed exceptional talent and poise.","It's a great story if you're not familiar with it, and if you like it you might want to explore other cast productions or recordings.","Nice to see Mr. Depp as well."],"dislike":["The premise of the plot also seems to be a point of contention for others, citing too many different stories and unhappy endings.","The show in general is very clever and captivating despite being compromised of familiar ones. (implied disappointment from theatre buffs)","I missed the missing Agony part two.","It was a little too modern-teenage-girl with the head bobbing and pithy language."]}
